If k→0+ and ν→∞ in such a way that k2⁢ν⁢(ν+1)=4⁢θ (a positive constant), then

29.5.7 lim𝐸𝑐νm⁡(z,k2) =cem⁡(12⁢π−z,θ),
lim𝐸𝑠νm⁡(z,k2) =sem⁡(12⁢π−z,θ),
ⓘ
